Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez kick off the Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast by revisiting Marvel Studios’ The Avengers (2012). They break down Loki's machinations, the Battle of New York, and the quotes that built the MCU's foundation, tracing how this original team-up still echoes through future iterations of the Avengers team.
